title: ExperienceView
description: The only read surface for an experience reference. It reports readability and, when not available, null body: it never returns summaries, fragments or counts, and an unauthorized read is uniformly unavailable. processing is in_progress or one of the nine terminal interaction results.

origin_kind.description: Provenance of the referenced object: user_statement is a direct user statement, host_supplied is trusted host material that is not a direct user statement, model_output is a model result, deterministic_query is a deterministic query result. host_supplied is only a provenance label: it is not factual validation and never makes the view evidence (R1).

body.description: Present iff readability is available (semantic rule R11); otherwise null, never a redaction marker or a fragment.

context_ref.description: Context of the object: for an input view, the Context of its representative interaction; for an artifact view, the artifact's own Context. null is allowed only for an input view whose representative interaction has not been bound to a Context yet. It is neither a hidden Context nor a deleted one (deletion is expressed by readability), and an artifact view is always non-null. The field remains required; only its value may be null.
